sections.name: EventRoom
sections.title: Full room shape for one event
sections.what: Describes everything on one event's page: the win chart with its model name, the peak leverage moment, a no-model explanation, stories with their proof, the observed time range, the proof and the credit text.
sections.why: The comments explain the chart's points and what leverage means.
sections.watch_out: The chart and leverage are null when there is no model, so pages must handle nulls.

summary: Defines the shapes of room list entries and full event rooms.
purpose: Tells the room pages what a room contains.
why: Likely reason: one shared description keeps the service and the pages in step.
how: 1. The summary holds the slug, name, competition and season. 2. The sport list holds the entries plus a reason when empty. 3. A full room adds the sport, the win chart with its model name, the leverage peak, the reason no model applies, stories with proof, the observed range, the proof and the credit line.
risks: Types cannot confirm data at runtime. Observed time fields can be undefined when no incidents exist.
debug: If a room page shows blanks, check that the chart and no-model reason are handled when null.
